title: Lifted inner product bounded by the Cauchy–Schwarz bound
statement: Let $n,k,r\in\mathbb N$, let $e:[r]\hookrightarrow[k]$ be an injection, and let $F$ be a real-valued family indexed by the $r$-dimensional Boolean cube with values that are functions on the $n$-dimensional Boolean cube. Lift $F$ to dimension $k$ by evaluating it on the restriction of each $k$-cube point along $e$. The Gowers inner product of this lifted family is at most the recursively defined Cauchy–Schwarz bound: at dimension zero this is the diagonal inner product, and at each successor dimension it is the product of the square roots of the bounds for the two slices obtained by fixing the last coordinate to $0$ and to $1$.
hypotheses_covered: $F$ is a real-valued family on the indicated cubes
